name: NLCD_LndCov
description: NLCD_LndCov provides land-cover classification data derived from the National Land Cover Database (NLCD) for remote sensing and environmental analysis tasks. It is intended to measure model ability to classify/label land-cover types (e.g., urban, forest, water) from geospatial/raster inputs. The benchmark supports evaluation of per-pixel or patch-level classification approaches used in environmental monitoring and mapping.
reputation: A domain-specific dataset derived from NLCD sources; commonly used in remote sensing and environmental mapping research but not a mainstream LLM benchmark.
